units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 4. Citizens who previously served in state service, hold class ranks, diplomatic ranks, military ranks or special ranks, and enter municipal service may be awarded a class rank above the minimum for the relevant group of municipal service positions.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 5. A citizen holding a state civil service class rank who enters municipal service is awarded a municipal servant’s class rank on their initiative, based on qualification examination results or without an examination, in accordance with the table of correspondence between state civil service class ranks and municipal servants’ class ranks, from the date of appointment to a municipal service position:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 6. A municipal servant may be awarded the next class rank no earlier than one year after being awarded the previous class rank.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 7. A municipal servant may be awarded the next class rank before one year has elapsed since the previous award if appointed to a higher municipal service position within the same group of positions, but no earlier than six months after appointment.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 8. When a municipal servant is appointed to a higher municipal service position in another group of positions, they may be awarded, out of sequence, the minimum class rank for the relevant group, but no earlier than six months after appointment.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 9. The representative body awards a class rank to a municipal servant holding the position of head of administration under contract.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 10. Except in the case provided for by Part 9 of this Article, the employer’s representative (employer) awards a class rank to a municipal servant.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 11. Information on the class rank awarded to a municipal servant is entered in their employment record book (if any).
units.label: Part 11 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 12. A municipal servant may be deprived of an awarded class rank by a court sentence. The employer’s representative’s (employer’s) legal act awarding a class rank may be revoked by a corresponding legal act of the employer’s representative (employer) if the servant submitted forged documents or knowingly false information on the basis of which the rank was awarded, or if the procedure for awarding class ranks established by this Law was violated.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 13. The official salary supplement for a class rank is paid from the date on which the corresponding rank is awarded to the municipal servant.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 14. A class rank awarded to a municipal servant is retained upon termination of municipal service.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 25. Individual labour disputes in municipal service
units.text: Article 25. Individual labour disputes in municipal service
units.label: Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Individual labour disputes in municipal service
units.text: 1. An individual labour dispute in municipal service (hereinafter, an individual labour dispute) means unresolved disagreements between the employer’s representative (employer) and a municipal servant or a citizen entering or formerly in municipal service concerning the application of federal legislation and normative legal acts of the City of Moscow on municipal service and the employment agreement (contract), which have been referred to a body considering individual labour disputes.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Individual labour disputes in municipal service
units.text: 2. Labour dispute commissions and courts are the bodies that consider individual labour disputes.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Individual labour disputes in municipal service
units.text: 3. A labour dispute commission is formed on the initiative of municipal servants and/or the employer’s representative (employer), with equal numbers of representatives of the municipal servants and of the employer’s representative (employer).
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Individual labour disputes in municipal service
units.text: 4. The head of the local self-government body appoints the employer’s (employer’s representative’s) representatives to the labour dispute commission. Municipal servants’ representatives are elected to the commission in accordance with the procedure established by labour legislation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Individual labour disputes in municipal service
units.text: 5. The employer’s representative (employer) approves the regulations on the labour dispute commission.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Individual labour disputes in municipal service
units.text: 6. An individual labour dispute is considered in the procedure established by federal legislation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 26. Termination of an employment contract with a municipal servant
units.text: Article 26. Termination of an employment contract with a municipal servant
units.label: Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Termination of an employment contract with a municipal servant
units.text: 1. Municipal service terminates on the date the employment agreement (contract) is terminated and the municipal servant is dismissed from the municipal service position.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Termination of an employment contract with a municipal servant
units.text: 2. The employment agreement with a municipal servant is terminated if they fail to comply with restrictions and prohibitions related to municipal service provided for by the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation” and this Law, and also in the procedure and on the grounds provided for by labour legislation and other federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Termination of an employment contract with a municipal servant
units.text: 3. The powers of the head of administration exercised under contract terminate early in the cases established by the Federal Law “On the General Principles of the Organisation of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation”.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Termination of an employment contract with a municipal servant
units.text: 4. Repealed. — Law of the City of Moscow of 21.12.2011 No. 68.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 26

units.locator: Chapter 5. WORKING (OFFICIAL DUTY) TIME AND REST TIME
units.text: Chapter 5. WORKING (OFFICIAL DUTY) TIME AND REST TIME
units.label: Chapter 5. WORKING (OFFICIAL DUTY) TIME AND REST TIME

units.locator: Article 27. Working (official duty) time
units.text: Article 27. Working (official duty) time
units.label: Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Working (official duty) time
units.text: 1. Working (service) time means the time during which a municipal servant must perform official duties in accordance with the local self-government body’s service rules, service schedule and terms of the employment agreement (contract), as well as other periods classified as service time by federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Working (official duty) time
units.text: 2. A municipal servant’s normal working (service) time may not exceed 40 hours per week. A five-day working (service) week is established for municipal servants.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Working (official duty) time
units.text: 3. The list of municipal servants’ positions with irregular working hours is established by a municipal legal act of the representative body.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant
units.text: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant
units.label: Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant
units.text: 1. A municipal servant is granted annual paid leave with retention of the municipal service position held and remuneration, the amount of which is determined in the procedure established by labour legislation for calculating average wages.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant
units.text: 2. A municipal servant’s annual paid leave consists of basic paid leave and additional paid leave. Annual basic paid leave and annual additional paid leave are added together.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant
units.text: 3. Municipal servants are granted annual basic paid leave of 30 calendar days.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant
units.text: 4. Annual additional paid leave is granted to a municipal servant for length of service (no more than 10 calendar days) and in the cases provided for by federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant
units.text: 5. Annual additional paid leave for length of service is calculated at one calendar day for each year of municipal service.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant
units.text: 5.1. A municipal servant subject to an irregular working day is granted additional annual paid leave of three calendar days for that working arrangement.
units.label: Part 5.1 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant
units.text: 6. At a municipal servant’s request, annual paid leave may be granted in parts. One part of the leave granted must be no shorter than 14 calendar days.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant
units.text: 7. On a municipal servant’s written application, the employer’s representative (employer) may decide to grant unpaid leave of no more than one year. Unpaid leave is also granted in the cases provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant
units.text: 8. Failure to grant a municipal servant annual paid leave for two consecutive years is prohibited.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant
units.text: 9. Remuneration for a municipal servant’s annual paid leave must be paid at least 10 calendar days before the leave begins.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 29. Monetary remuneration of a municipal servant
units.text: Article 29. Monetary remuneration of a municipal servant
units.label: Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Monetary remuneration of a municipal servant
units.text: 1. Local self-government bodies independently determine the amounts and terms of municipal servants’ pay. The official salary amount, amounts of monthly and other additional payments and the procedure for making them are established by municipal legal acts in accordance with federal legislation and laws of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Monetary remuneration of a municipal servant
units.text: 2. A municipal servant is paid in the form of remuneration comprising an official salary corresponding to the municipal service position held (hereinafter, official salary), monthly monetary incentives, official salary supplements for class rank, length of service and special municipal service conditions, a lump-sum payment for regular annual paid leave, material assistance, and bonuses for performing especially important and complex assignments.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Monetary remuneration of a municipal servant
units.text: 3. Repealed. — Law of the City of Moscow of 16.09.2009 No. 34.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Monetary remuneration of a municipal servant
units.text: 4. Budget appropriations for municipal servants’ pay in municipal formations are planned according to payroll fund formation standards established for state civil servants by normative legal acts of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation
units.text: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation
units.label: Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation
units.text: 1. In accordance with federal legislation, a municipal servant is guaranteed:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation
units.text: 1) working conditions that enable performance of official duties in accordance with the job description;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation
units.text: 2) the right to receive monetary remuneration on time and in full;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation
units.text: 3) rest, ensured through standard working (service) hours, days off and non-working public holidays, and annual paid leave;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation
units.text: 4) medical care for the municipal servant and members of the servant’s family, including after the servant retires;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation
units.text: 5) pensions for length of service and disability, and pensions for family members if the municipal servant dies in connection with the performance of official duties, in the procedure and on the terms established by federal law;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation
units.text: 6) compulsory state insurance against harm to the municipal servant’s life, health or property in connection with the performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation
units.text: 7) compulsory state social insurance against illness or incapacity for work arising during municipal service or after its termination, but in connection with the performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation
units.text: 8) protection of the municipal servant, including their family members, against violence, threats and other unlawful actions in connection with the performance of official duties, in the cases, procedure and on the terms established by federal law.
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation
units.text: 2. When an employment agreement with a municipal servant is terminated because a local self-government body is liquidated or its staff is reduced, the servant is provided with the guarantees established by federal legislation for employees dismissed because an organisation is liquidated or its staff is reduced.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation
units.text: 3. The municipal servant’s family members referred to in Points 4, 5 and 8 of Part 1 of this Article mean the spouse, minor children, children over 18 who became disabled before reaching 18, and children under 23 studying full-time in basic educational programmes at organisations engaged in educational activities.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation
units.text: 4. The representative body determines the procedure for providing a municipal servant with the basic state guarantees established by this Article.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.text: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.label: Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.text: 1. In addition to basic state guarantees established by federal legislation, a municipal servant is provided with additional guarantees in accordance with this Law, other laws of the City of Moscow and the charters of municipal formations.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
units.text: 2. A municipal servant is guaranteed:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 31
